_about: Decisions that correct Buildium's lease records. Applied by tools/buildium/rentals_sql.py; each one is also written to ledger_corrections. The raw Buildium export in incoming/ is never edited. CONTAINS TENANT NAMES: gitignored.

corrections.subject: Andrew Cannon — Unit 12 lease entered in error
corrections.reason: Andrew Cannon is in Unit 2. Buildium opened a lease on Unit 12 by mistake (7/1–7/7/2026, left 'Active'), took his 6/18/2026 card payments there, then 'moved' them to Unit 2 with two manual-cash entries and charged the $1,800 deposit a second time. The Unit 12 lease is removed; his real charges and payments move to his Unit 2 lease; the two transfer entries and the duplicate deposit charge are removed.

corrections.subject: 3446 N. 12th Street is a land contract, not a tenancy
corrections.reason: 3446 N. 12th Street is a land contract, not a tenancy. Buildium recorded it as an at-will lease with 'rent'. The buyers rented under a 2019 lease from 12/30/2019 until the land contract (dated 3/2/2020, recorded 3/5/2020), then paid installments from 4/1/2020. Imported as a land contract with its full payment history and the Exhibit A amortization schedule.
